name: io.github.walter-kudzai-kamanga/megmis
title: Mamiriro (MEGMIS)
description: PROTOTYPE: Zimbabwe-focused weather, geospatial, safe routing, road conditions, and journey-risk via REST + MCP (stdio). Default providers are mocks; optional live adapters via env. Not a production SLA.

environmentVariables.name: DEV_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key used for mutating tools and tenant-scoped persistence (optional for read-only local demos).

environmentVariables.name: USE_PERSISTENCE
environmentVariables.description: Set false for in-memory/mock-friendly local stdio without Postgres/Redis.

environmentVariables.name: ROUTING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Routing adapter: mock | osrm | valhalla | graphhopper
